reason: The v1 implementation used the 256-pixel descriptor resize as the render input, so its automatic evidence and blind observations are preview-only and cannot close the full-resolution product-value or severe-artifact gate.
decision: Do not decode or promote the v1 blind observations. Preserve the outputs, keep every numerical and blind threshold unchanged, and rerun a separately versioned v2 whose descriptor is resized but whose explicit operator and AO6 execute on exact decoded pixels.
